title_zh: 为课堂代表选举安排发言与投票程序

scenario.label_zh: 设计课堂学生议会的选举程序
scenario.goal_zh: 商定让不同学生表达意见并以投票选出代表的流程

context_zh: 公民课堂中的师生为虚构班级代表选举讨论参与流程，不针对真实政治选举。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: If this is an exercise in democracy, shouldn't everyone have a chance to speak before we elect a representative?

sentences.speaker: Mr Patel
sentences.text: Yes. What would make the process more democratic than simply choosing whoever speaks first?

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: We could hear from every candidate, then let everyone vote privately.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patel
sentences.text: That would give quieter students a way to express their choice too.

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: Our class is quite diverse, but the same three people usually lead every discussion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patel
sentences.text: Then let's invite questions from everyone. We may hear a greater diversity of views if people can write their questions down.

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: I'll put out a question box. Can we give each candidate the same amount of speaking time?

sentences.speaker: Mr Patel
sentences.text: Agreed. Equal speaking time, written questions, and a private vote at the end. We'll explain that process before anyone stands.

targets.sense_zh: 由成员参与决定或选举代表的民主方式
按民主参与原则进行的
多样的；由不同背景成员组成的
